Project 01 · Motion / 3D

Mustang GT teaser

A 33-second cinematic teaser built from tight close-ups: headlight, grille, wheel, bodywork and the GT badge. Light does the storytelling, slow reveals build anticipation, and the car is never shown in full.

FormatTeaser, 16:9
Length33 seconds

Project 02 · UX / UI

DUBC basketball app

A mobile app for the Deakin University Basketball Club, built so members and newcomers can find pickup games, see who's going, and join a team without digging through group chats.

  • Problem. Games were organised in group chats, so newcomers had no clear way in.
  • Audience. Regular members who want speed, and new players who want a low-pressure first game.
  • Research. Compared an event app and a sport-booking app; kept attendee avatars, a separate schedule view and guest sign-up.
  • Redesign. One consistent tab bar, higher text contrast, and a single orange accent so the next action is always obvious.
  • Next. Test with real club members and design empty and error states.
